poor experience when I sought help with an eye infection.  I was told that the surgery didn't deal with minor eye problems which they had outsourced to a clinic at Specsavers and that I would have to go there.
So I went to the Specsavers in Sainsbury's where they diagnosed a style under my lower eyelid.  So far, so good.  However, when it came to the treatment I was told I would have to go to a chemist and buy specific eye drops, they didn't give me a prescription for this medication.
To make matters worse, when I went to Boots they didn't have the drops and gave me a tube of ointment instead and I had to pay nearly £10 for it.
Because I was due to go into hospital within days for knee replacement surgery I didn't have time to contact the surgery to query all this.  I knew that the operation might not go ahead if I still had an infection.
